name: dashboard-profiles
description: Local full-page QA sweep for all dashboard profiles. `scripts/capture.ps1` resolves the clone path and writes ignored evidence to storage/screenshots by default.

notes.local: Use scripts/capture.ps1; it replaces <repo-root> in a temporary ignored config so file:// capture works from any clone path.
notes.collapseVariants: Produces both expanded and collapsed variants per page × breakpoint.
notes.webp: Requires ffmpeg on PATH. Install: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg
